lines.en: label undeservedfuture18:
scene ineedyouback1
scene ineedyouback2
: I could have handled that, you know.
lines.zh: : 我本来可以处理的，你知道。

lines.en: : It must have been hard for you.
lines.zh: : 对你来说一定很难。

lines.en: : It’s my fault it came to this in the first place...
lines.zh: : 会走到这一步，本来就是我的错……

lines.en: : I needed to be the one who did it.
lines.zh: : 我必须亲自动手。

lines.en: : Fitting that you’d choose the most dramatic moment possible to start acting mature.
lines.zh: : 你偏偏选在最戏剧化的一刻才开始表现得成熟，倒是很符合你的风格。

lines.en: : Do you think they’ll forgive me, Shi-chan?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他们会原谅我吗，Shi 酱？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback3
: I’d hope not. That would imply they remember you.
lines.zh: : 我希望不会。那意味着他们还记着你。

lines.en: : If they ever find out, I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果他们有朝一日发现了的话……

lines.en: : We don’t know how this world works. And my mom knew my name when I came to the roof, so...
lines.zh: : 我们不知道这个世界怎么运作。而我上屋顶的时候妈妈是知道我的名字的，所以……

lines.en: scene ineedyouback2
: Hm.
: Say they do...
lines.zh: : 假设他们真的发现了……

lines.en: : Then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : Will you risk even more to come back?
lines.zh: : 你会冒更大的风险回来吗？
: 我{i}可以{/i}吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t want them to take {i}mine{/i} next. I need to hang onto these memories, no matter how painful they may be.
lines.zh: : 我不想让下一个被抹掉记忆的人是{i}我{/i}。我需要留住这些记忆，不管它们有多痛。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}need{/i} to. I could fix you right now. Make it so this never happened at all.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不需要{/i}。我现在就能把你修好。让这一切根本没发生过。

lines.en: : Though, I guess that’s why you’re so afraid of being caught in the first place. So forget I said anything.
lines.zh: : 不过，我猜这正是你一开始就害怕被抓的原因。所以当我没说。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback4
: You did the right thing, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 你做了正确的事，Himawari。

lines.en: : They’d surely mope forever if they only knew what they lost.
lines.zh: : 如果他们知道失去了什么，肯定会一直消沉下去。

lines.en: : They really were the best parents a girl could ask for.
lines.zh: : 他们真的是女孩子能求到的最好的父母。

lines.en: : It’s not fair that they have to suffer like this.
lines.zh: : 他们不得不承受这些，太不公平了。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback2
: There’s someone suffering in every world. No amount of wishing will ever change that.
lines.zh: : 每个世界里都有人在受苦。再多的愿望也改变不了这一点。

lines.en: : I will...one day.
lines.zh: : 我会的……总有一天。

lines.en: : I’ll take what I’ve learned here and use it to make my dreams come true. Turn the world into a better place. One that’s free of caveats or monkeys’ paws.
lines.zh: : 我会把在这里学到的东西用上，让我的梦想成真。把世界变成一个更好的地方。一个没有附加条件、没有猴爪的地方。

lines.en: : This again? Your interdimensional travel agency?
lines.zh: : 又来了？你那家跨次元旅行社？

lines.en: : It’s more than that and you know it.
lines.zh: : 不止如此，你是知道的。

lines.en: : We all have dreams, Shiori-Senpai. Even you. You just won’t tell me the world that {i}you{/i} want.
lines.zh: : 我们都有梦想，Shiori 前辈。连你也有。你只是不肯告诉我{i}你{/i}想要的世界。

lines.en: : It keeps you from interfering, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那样你就没法干涉了，不是吗？

lines.en: : I might not be able to interfere at all soon...
lines.zh: : 说不定很快我就根本没法干涉了……

lines.en: : Will you watch over them if that happens? Make sure they don’t give up?
lines.zh: : 如果真到了那一步，你会替我看着他们吗？确保他们不会放弃？

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: : This place {i}is{/i} somewhat interesting. Despite how badly I wanted it to be boring.
lines.zh: : 这地方还挺{i}有{/i}意思的。尽管我那么希望它无聊。

lines.en: : I imagine I’ll be back eventually. Assuming it actually lasts, which seems like a pretty big toss-up right now.
lines.zh: : 我想我迟早会回来的。前提是它真的能撑住，不过现在看来还真不好说。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback5
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: scene ineedyouback6
: There’s a girl here that interests me. I knew someone who looked like her once.
lines.zh: : 这儿有个女孩让我感兴趣。我以前认识一个长得像她的人。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback7
: What? {i}Who?{/i}
: That’s all you’re getting. Which is already too much.
lines.zh: : 你只能知道这些。而且这已经说太多了。

lines.en: : Now, go. I’ll handle things from here. You’ve done enough and I don’t want you crying on me.
lines.zh: : 好了，走吧。剩下的我来。你做得够多了，我可不想你哭在我身上。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback8
: ...Okay. But I’m asking you more about this next week.
lines.zh: : ……好吧。不过这件事我下周还要再问你。

lines.en: : Two weeks from now would be preferable. I’m having you cover my next five shifts to make up for the fact that I am now an accomplice in corporate heresy. Remember?
lines.zh: : 最好两周后。你要替我顶接下来五个班，来弥补我现在成了「公司异端」的共犯这件事。记得吗？

lines.en: : That’s fine...I figured it’d be more, honestly.
lines.zh: : 没关系……说实话我以为会更多。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback9
: It would be if you weren’t in such a pathetic state right now. I can’t help but feel bad for you.
lines.zh: : 如果你现在不是这么一副惨样的话，本来会更多的。我忍不住同情你。

lines.en: : Thank you, Senpai. Again.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，前辈。又一次。

lines.en: : It really means a lot.
lines.zh: : 真的对我意义重大。

lines.en: : So, where will you go next? The orchids are in bloom at Haadiya’s. You like flowers, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 那么，你接下来去哪儿？Haadiya 那边的兰花开了。你喜欢花，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: There’s somewhere else I want to be right now, though...
lines.zh: : 不过现在我想去的是别的地方……

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah.
: Should have seen that coming.
lines.zh: : 早该想到的。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback10
: Tadaima...
lines.zh: : 我回来了……

lines.en: scene ineedyouback11
: Hah...
: Wishful thinking will get you nowhere, Hima-chan.
lines.zh: : 光是空想是不会有任何结果的，Hima 酱。

lines.en: scene black
: The future’s in their hands now...
lines.zh: : 未来现在在他们手里了……

lines.en: scene ineedyouback12
: But I guess I still have you in the meantime, Che Guevara.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，这段日子里我还有你，Che Guevara。

lines.en: : I imagine it’ll be quiet here for a while. I’ll take you with me, though. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我想这里会安静一阵子。不过我会带你走的。我保证。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback13
: There’s no rule against rabbits, thankfully. We just need to make sure you don’t become another bootstrap. Those fines add up, you know.
lines.zh: : 幸好没有不许养兔子的规矩。我们只要确保你不会变成另一个 bootstrap 就行。那罚款可是会累积的，你知道。

lines.en: : Hey...
scene black
: You won’t feel lonely if I sleep in {i}their{/i} bed tonight...
lines.zh: : 如果我今晚睡在{i}他们的{/i}床上，你不会觉得孤独吧……

lines.en: : {i}Will you?{/i}
scene ineedyouback14
scene black
scene ineedyouback15
: Why do I feel like something terrible just happened to us?
lines.zh: : 为什么我觉得刚刚有什么可怕的事发生在我们身上？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback16
: Right?! It’s like there’s a huge part of me missing all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 对吧？！就像我突然少了一大块似的。

lines.en: : I feel like you’ve said something similar before.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你以前说过类似的话。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback17
: It has to be a reset, right? Weren’t we just at the beach? Or the...rooftop? I don’t know. You go.
lines.zh: : 一定是重置了吧？我们刚才不是在海滩吗？还是……屋顶？我不知道。你说。

lines.en: : I think you’re right. But there’s...all this other stuff still swimming around in my head and...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是对的。可是……脑子里还飘着一大堆别的东西，而且……

lines.en: : Uhh...Aomori doesn’t ring a bell, does it?
lines.zh: : 呃……Aomori，听着耳熟吗？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback18
: It definitely does to {i}me!{/i} But why does it ring a bell to {i}you?!{/i} Stop looking into my dreams! It’s embarrassing!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}当然耳熟！可为什么{i}你{/i}也耳熟？！别再偷看我的梦了！太丢人了！

lines.en: : No, I...I think I had the same one. We were married, right?
lines.zh: : 不，我……我觉得我做了同样的梦。我们结婚了，对吧？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback19
: What part of “embarrassing” don’t you understand?!
lines.zh: : 「丢人」两个字你是哪部分听不懂？！

lines.en: : Hey, guys?
lines.zh: : 嗨，两位？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback20
: You’re both cute and all, but maybe stop flirting in public and wait until we’re at the hotel to kick things up a notch. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 你们俩是很可爱啦，不过能不能别在大庭广众下调情，等到了酒店再升级，谢谢。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你们真恶心。

lines.en: We’re thrown right into the thick of things again, it seems.
lines.zh: 看来我们又被直接扔回了事情的中心。

lines.en: But without much time for reprieve, all I can do is rapidly flip through the pages of mental notes I must have scribbled between my last conscious moment and now.
lines.zh: 但没多少喘息的时间，我只能快速翻阅那些在我上一个清醒时刻到现在之间、我大概胡乱记下的心理笔记。

lines.en: Ayane and I made it through another reset. But I have no idea what that means for everyone else.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我又熬过了一次重置。但我不知道那对其他人意味着什么。

lines.en: {i}Nor{/i} do I understand why I’m suddenly suspicious of Ami or why looking at Maya fills me with an even deeper sense of dread than normal. Maybe Ayane can help fill me in on that, though.
lines.zh: {i}我也不{/i}明白为什么我突然怀疑起 Ami，或者为什么看着 Maya 会让我比平时更加恐惧。不过也许 Ayane 能帮我补上这块。

lines.en: But the question now is {i}when.{/i} Because it is apparently Halloween and we are even more apparently on the way to a hotel right now.
lines.zh: 但现在的问题是{i}什么时候{/i}。因为现在显然是万圣节，而我们更显然正在去一家酒店的路上。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, you guys have been acting pretty weird all morning. Where’s all your Christmalloween spirit?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你们俩今天一早上都怪怪的。你们的圣诞万圣节精神哪儿去了？

lines.en: : Sorry. Our {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我们的{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Christmalloween spirit. You know — the spirit of Christmalloween. The thing that powers Santa’s sleigh so he can deliver candy to kids in costumes all across the globe.
lines.zh: : 圣诞万圣节精神啊。你知道的——Christmalloween 的精神。就是给圣诞老人的雪橇供能、好让他给全世界穿着 costumes 的孩子们送糖果的那股精神。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback21
: Oh no. We’ve finally broken the world.
lines.zh: : 不好。我们终于把世界搞坏了。

lines.en: : Ami, there’s Christmas and there’s Halloween. Stop making up holidays just to fuck with me while my brain is clearly in a state of sudden recovery.
lines.zh: : Ami，有圣诞节，也有万圣节。别在我脑子明显处于突然恢复状态的时候，编造节日来耍我。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback22
: Please be advised that all limited express trains on the Christmalloween holiday timetable are facing delays of up to five minutes.
lines.zh: : 提醒各位乘客，因 Christmalloween 假日时刻表，所有特快列车将延误最多五分钟。

lines.en: : The next limited express train bound for Shiori-eki is arriving at platform two now.
lines.zh: : 下一班开往 Shiori-eki 的特快列车即将到达二号站台。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god. We {i}did{/i} break the world.
lines.zh: : 哦我操。我们{i}真的{/i}把世界搞坏了。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback23
: If something’s wrong, we can always go back home. I’m kind of worried that everyone is going to hit on me tonight anyway. This whole masculine look works shockingly well for me, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 如果哪里不对劲，我们随时可以回家。反正我还有点担心今晚所有人都会来搭讪我。这身中性打扮意外地很适合我，不是吗？

lines.en: : We can swap costumes if that’s something you’re actually worried about, Ami. Because if one more person bumps into my tail, I’m going to throw them onto the tracks.
lines.zh: : 如果你真那么担心，我们可以换 costumes，Ami。因为要是再有一个人撞到我的尾巴，我就把他们扔到铁轨上去。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback24
: Just take the tail part off then. You’re the one who decided to wear such a complicated costume to the station on the busiest day of the year.
lines.zh: : 那就把尾巴那部分摘掉啊。明明是你自己非要穿这么复杂的 costume 来车站，还挑一年里最挤的一天。

lines.en: : I can’t. There’s a gaping hole in the back of the costume that the tail plugs into. And I’m not about to invite an entire train worth of people to screw me from behind.
lines.zh: : 不行。costume 后面有个洞，尾巴就是插在那上面的。我可不想邀请一整列车的人从后面干我。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback25
: That’s what your dad is for.
lines.zh: : 那是给你爸留的。

lines.en: : You know what? Maybe we {i}should{/i} swap costumes.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？也许我们{i}该{/i}换 costumes。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, Maya! To the restroom! We’ll catch the next-
lines.zh: : 走了，Maya！去洗手间！我们赶下一班——

lines.en: : Ah! No! Don’t just get on! Your idea was good!
lines.zh: : 啊！不行！别就这么上车！你的主意挺好的啊！

lines.en: scene ineedyouback26
: Okay, so...Halloween and Christmas have combined into one holiday. That’s...{i}fine.{/i} That’s not {i}that{/i} big of a change, right? It could be worse!
lines.zh: : 好吧，这么说……万圣节和圣诞节合并成了一个节日。那……{i}还好{/i}。不算{i}那么{/i}大的变化，对吧？本来可能更糟的！

lines.en: : Oh, sure. It could {i}definitely{/i} be worse. But if something like {i}that{/i} changed, who knows what else we’re going to find out next?
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。{i}绝对{/i}可能更糟。但如果连{i}这种事{/i}都变了，谁知道接下来我们还会发现什么？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback27
: M...Maybe there are some {i}good{/i} changes too! Like maybe, they’ve lowered the legal age of-
lines.zh: : 也……也许有些变化是{i}好的{/i}呢！比如，他们把法定年龄……

lines.en: : Yeah, or maybe they’ve {i}raised{/i} it and legalized guns and you’re about to get me murdered in the middle of a crowded train. This is not the time to be optimistic, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 是啊，或者他们{i}提高{/i}了法定年龄、还把枪合法化了，而你马上就要让我在拥挤的列车上被人谋杀了。现在不是乐观的时候，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback28
: Well, I’m sorry! But being optimistic is the only way I know how to keep myself from crying right now! I’m really serious about feeling like something’s missing!
lines.zh: : 好吧，对不起！可乐观是我现在唯一知道的、能让自己不哭出来的办法！我是真的觉得少了点什么！

lines.en: : Me too. I {i}get{/i} it. But there’s a ton of shit I’m feeling right now that I don’t know what to make of. Take Ami and Maya for example.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我{i}懂{/i}。但我现在有一大堆感觉不知道该怎么理解的东西。拿 Ami 和 Maya 举例吧。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback29
: I know. Ami looks {i}annoyingly{/i} hot in that costume. {i}I’m{/i} supposed to be the hot one. This isn’t fair.
lines.zh: : 我知道。Ami 穿那身 costume {i}烦人地{/i}性感。本该是性感的那个是{i}我{/i}。这不公平。

lines.en: : That’s not what I mean and you know it...
lines.zh: : 我不是这个意思，你知道的……

lines.en: scene ineedyouback30
: You feel like she knows something too then?
lines.zh: : 那你也觉得她知道些什么了？

lines.en: : {i}There{/i} you go. But why?
lines.zh: : {i}这就{/i}对了。可为什么呢？

lines.en: : To be honest, I’ve felt that way for a while. Something about the way she acts with Maya sets off all sorts of alarms in my head.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有这种感觉有一阵子了。她跟 Maya 相处的方式，让我脑子里各种警报响个不停。

lines.en: : It’s definitely stronger now, though. You don’t think something happened with her during the apocalypse, do you?
lines.zh: : 不过现在强烈多了。你不会觉得末日的时候她身上发生了什么事吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I...
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我……

lines.en: : I remember her bringing me some sort of gift at the beach. But everything after that is-
lines.zh: : 我记得她在海滩上给我带了什么礼物。但那之后的一切就——

lines.en: scene aboxabox43
scene ineedyouback31
: Ngh?!
: Akira? Are you okay? You look really sick all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : Akira？你还好吗？你突然看起来很不舒服。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m fine. I...what did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没事。我……你刚才叫我什么？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback32
: Akira. Your...name?
lines.zh: : Akira。你的……名字？

lines.en: : Yeah, but don’t you normally call me Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你平时不是叫我 Sensei 吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t I start calling you Akira recently? Calling you Sensei feels kind of weird now.
lines.zh: : 我最近不是开始叫你 Akira 了吗？现在叫你 Sensei 感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : Just...forget the names for a second. We need to try and figure out what’s going on here. This feels different from the other resets.
lines.zh: : 先……先别管称呼。我们得想办法搞清楚这儿发生了什么。这次感觉跟之前的重置不一样。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback33
: I agree. Let’s meet up with Makoto once we get to the hotel and see if she has anything to add.
lines.zh: : 我同意。等到了酒店我们先跟 Makoto 碰头，看看她有没有什么补充。

lines.en: : I’ll try talking to Ami once we get off the train too, but I can’t guarantee she’ll tell me anything given the type of girl she is. That said-
lines.zh: : 下车后我也会试着跟 Ami 谈谈，不过考虑到她是那种女孩，我不能保证她会告诉我什么。不过——

lines.en: : I’ll talk to Maya. I just...don’t really know what to talk to her {i}about{/i} since the theory floating around in my head right now is utterly ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 我去跟 Maya 谈。只是……我真不知道该跟她谈{i}什么{/i}，因为现在在我脑子里打转的那个理论简直荒谬透顶。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback34
: Just out of curiosity, that theory wouldn’t happen to be that Kumon-mi is a world of her creation and that we all just got sucked into it, right?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇一下，那个理论该不会是——Kumon-mi 是她创造的世界，而我们全都被卷进来了吧？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback28
: Just what the heck happened in this reset?!
lines.zh: : 这次重置到底发生了什么啊？！

lines.en: scene ineedyouback35
: Maya. Wait up a second.
lines.zh: : Maya。等一下。

lines.en: : You sure that’s a good idea with your niece and girlfriend so close by? I think the mistress normally needs to wait.
lines.zh: : 你侄女和你女朋友就在旁边，你确定这么做合适？我觉得情妇一般得等着。

lines.en: : You’re not my mistress. I just need to talk to you about something. And I understand that this probably isn’t the right time, but-
lines.zh: : 你不是我的情妇。我只是需要跟你谈点事。我也明白现在大概不是时候，可是——

lines.en: : It’s {i}definitely{/i} not the right time. Because either it’s {i}good{/i} and I become too clingy and piss Ami off. Or it’s {i}bad{/i} and we get into a big fight right before a party. And then I piss Ami off.
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}不是时候。因为如果是{i}好消息{/i}，我会变得太黏人，把 Ami 惹毛。如果是{i}坏消息{/i}，我们就在派对前大吵一架。然后我还是把 Ami 惹毛。

lines.en: : Ami’s basically just always pissed off at me now. So if you want to tell me anything, it needs to be in private. With our clothes off.
lines.zh: : Ami 现在基本上随时都在生我的气。所以如果你想跟我说什么，得私下说。而且要脱光衣服。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : Fine. That last part is optional. I’ll make an exception since it’s Christmalloween and I look hot in this costume.
lines.zh: : 好吧。最后那点可以选。我就破个例，毕竟今天是 Christmalloween，而我穿这身 costume 很好看。

lines.en: : Christmalloween isn’t a real holiday. Ayane and I just went through another reset and now even the calendar is somehow fucked up.
lines.zh: : Christmalloween 不是真的节日。Ayane 和我刚经历又一次重置，现在连日历都莫名其妙地乱了。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’ve come around to being a clone of myself. And I’ve come around to the apparent fact that this world is part of an infinitely repeating cycle.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我已经接受了自己是自己的克隆体这件事。我也接受了「这个世界是一个无限重复循环的一部分」这个明显的事实。

lines.en: : But you will {i}not{/i} convince me that Christmalloween isn’t real. That is where I draw the line.
lines.zh: : 但你{i}别想{/i}说服我 Christmalloween 不是真的。这是我的底线。

lines.en: : Maya, I’m being serious. And I think you’re somehow a major part of this.
lines.zh: : Maya，我是认真的。而且我觉得你在某种程度上是这件事的重要一环。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. I figured that to be the case as well given the {i}last{/i} me was willingly cuckolded for millions of years. What’s your point?
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。考虑到{i}上一个{/i}我自愿被戴了绿帽几百万年，我也猜到了。所以你想说什么？

lines.en: : My point is, I...
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，我……

lines.en: : What if...you {i}made{/i} this world?
lines.zh: : 如果……这个世界是你{i}造{/i}的呢？

lines.en: scene ineedyouback36
: {i}What?{/i}
: Like...say you made a wish one day. And-
lines.zh: : 比如……假设你某天许了个愿。然后——

lines.en: : Why in a {i}trillion{/i} years would I wish for a world like {i}this?{/i} This place sucks. I can’t even sleep with the guy I like because it makes him too sad.
lines.zh: : 我{i}一万亿{/i}年也不会许愿要一个{i}这样的{/i}世界吧。这地方烂透了。我连跟我喜欢的人睡觉都不行，因为那会让他太难过。

lines.en: : I...don’t really get it either. But when Ayane and I snapped out of it a little while ago, we were both thinking the same thing. Which means that there was probably something that-
lines.zh: : 我……也不太懂。但当 Ayane 和我刚才回过神来的时候，我们俩想的是同一件事。那说明大概有什么东西——

lines.en: : Implanted that thought in you because it wants to eliminate me. I read manga. I know how this works. But you don’t seriously believe that, do you?
lines.zh: : ——把这个念头植入了你们，因为它想除掉我。我看漫画的。我知道这套路。但你不会真信吧？

lines.en: : I’ve done everything you’ve asked. I’m open to learning all you know about this place. Don’t pivot to making me the antagonist now. That’s not fair at all.
lines.zh: : 你要求的事我都做了。我也愿意学你所知道的关于这个地方的一切。别现在突然把我变成反派。这一点都不公平。

lines.en: : I’m not calling you an antagonist at all. I’m just-
lines.zh: : 我根本没在叫你反派。我只是——

lines.en: : You’re {i}absolutely{/i} calling me an antagonist if you’re going to just blatantly blame me for creating the world where all you do is suffer and bitch and-
lines.zh: : 如果你就这么明目张胆地把「你在其中只会受苦和抱怨的世界」归咎于我，那你{i}就是{/i}在叫我反派——

lines.en: : Maya, I love you.
lines.zh: : Maya，我爱你。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback37
: Wha- now?!
lines.zh: : 什么——现在？！

lines.en: : I just-
lines.zh: : 我只是——

lines.en: scene ineedyouback38
: You say that {i}now?!{/i} Of all times?! On Christmalloween?! Literally sixty seconds after I tell you that I’ll get too clingy if you say anything good to me?! Are you insane?!
lines.zh: : 你居然{i}现在{/i}说？！挑这种时候？！在 Christmalloween？！就在我刚跟你说「只要你对我说好话我就会变得太黏人」的六十秒之后？！你疯了吗？！

lines.en: : {i}Probably.{/i} And there’s a good chance this could all be the result of some sort of delusion.
lines.zh: : {i}大概吧{/i}。而且这很可能全是某种妄想的结果。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback39
: But if it’s true, I...
lines.zh: : 但如果那是真的，我……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : There’s still...something missing. There’s a part I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 还是……少了点什么。有一部分我不明白。

lines.en: : I don’t know what to do if that {i}is{/i} true.
lines.zh: : 如果那{i}是{/i}真的，我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : But...you love me.
lines.zh: : 可是……你爱我。

lines.en: : {i}Me.{/i} Not the old Maya. You love {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我。{/i}不是以前那个 Maya。你爱的是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : I love both of you, I think. I just don’t know when I realized that.
lines.zh: : 我想，你们两个我都爱。我只是不知道自己是什么时候意识到这一点的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for...springing that on you out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉……就这么突然地跟你说这个。

lines.en: : Good. You {i}should{/i} be.
lines.zh: : 你{i}该{/i}抱歉。

lines.en: : Now, I believe it is my turn to apologize.
lines.zh: : 现在，轮到我来道歉了。

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 为什么道歉？

lines.en: : For what I am going to do to you tonight.
lines.zh: : 为我今晚要对你做的事。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback40
: I wonder if Miss Watabe is going to be at the party?
lines.zh: : 不知道 Watabe 老师会不会来派对？

lines.en: : I’ve been writing a lot more lately and I really like talking to her about-
lines.zh: : 我最近写得多了不少，我真的很喜欢跟她聊——

lines.en: : Ami, are you aware that we’re caught in a timeloop and are just pretending {i}not{/i} to know because you want to stay here forever?
lines.zh: : Ami，你知不知道我们被困在一个时间循环里，只是因为你想永远留在这儿才假装{i}不{/i}知道？

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 知道啊。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback41
: Hah...of course you wouldn’t just-
lines.zh: : 哈……你当然不会就——

lines.en: scene ineedyouback42
: Yeah?!?!?
: Mhm.
: You’re just going to admit it?! You’re not going to hide it or try and kill me for finding out?!
lines.zh: : 你就这么承认了？！你不打算掩饰一下，或者因为被我发现而杀了我？！

lines.en: : Why would I kill {i}you?{/i} I like you.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要杀{i}你{/i}？我喜欢你。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback43
: Because...isn’t it supposed to be a secret? Isn’t that something you’re trying to keep {i}away{/i} from everyone?
lines.zh: : 因为……那不是应该保密的吗？那不是你想{i}瞒着{/i}所有人的事吗？

lines.en: : Not everyone. Just Sensei. So if you’re planning on relaying this to him, tell me now and I {i}will{/i} kill you. But know that I will do it with a heavy heart. I might even shed a tear.
lines.zh: : 不是所有人。只有 Sensei。所以如果你打算把这事转告他，现在就告诉我，我{i}会{/i}杀了你。不过要知道，我会带着沉重的心情动手。我甚至可能会掉一滴眼泪。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback44
: Why just him?...
lines.zh: : 为什么只有他？……

lines.en: : Are you afraid he wouldn’t want to stay with you if he knew?...
lines.zh: : 你是怕他知道了就不想跟你在一起了吗？……

lines.en: : Of course not. I don’t question his love for me. But it’s {i}because{/i} of his love for me that I have to keep this a secret.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我不怀疑他对我的爱。但{i}正因为{/i}他爱我，我才必须保守这个秘密。

lines.en: : You see how he is with Maya. How all the time she spent searching for him is one more factor contributing to how upset he is about losing her.
lines.zh: : 你看到他对 Maya 是什么样了。她花了那么久寻找他，而这只是让他对失去她更加难过的一个因素。

lines.en: : You don’t want to make him go through that {i}again,{/i} do you? While he’s already questioning his adequacy as a father?
lines.zh: : 你不想让他{i}再{/i}经历一次那种事吧？何况他现在还在质疑自己当父亲是否称职。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback45
: If he finds out that I’m the same, it won’t be met with appreciation. It’ll be met by another panic attack and endless self-blame for not realizing it sooner. Then pity over what I’ve gone through.
lines.zh: : 如果他发现我也是一样，得到的不会是感激。而会是又一次惊恐发作，以及无尽的、怪自己没早点发现的自责。然后是对我所经历的一切的怜悯。

lines.en: : All things considered, I’d actually be the only one to {i}benefit{/i} from him learning. Just think of all the attention I’d get.
lines.zh: : 综合来看，他知道了以后唯一能{i}受益{/i}的人其实是我。想想我能得到多少关注吧。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback46
: It would come at the cost of his pain, though.
lines.zh: : 可那是以他的痛苦为代价的。

lines.en: : And if that pain became too great, I’d have no choice but to put him out of his misery.
lines.zh: : 而如果那份痛苦变得太大，我就别无选择，只能让他解脱了。

lines.en: scene ineedyouback47
: What...was that last part?
lines.zh: : 最后那句……是什么？

lines.en: : A threat. And one that I know you will heed out of love.
lines.zh: : 一个威胁。而且我知道，出于爱，你会听进去的。

lines.en: : So do yourself {i}and{/i} him a favor by staying in line or I will show you what it’s like to watch someone you love disappear. Do you under-
lines.zh: : 所以帮自己{i}和{/i}他一个忙，别越线，否则我会让你看看「看着你爱的人消失」是什么滋味。你明——

lines.en: scene ineedyouback48
: Ngh!
: ...stand?
: My head is...killing me all of a sudden! Are you...the one doing this?!
lines.zh: : 我的头……突然疼得要命！是……你在搞鬼吗？！

lines.en: : Yes, Ayane. My time as an immortal has granted me the power to give people headaches at will. Fear me.
lines.zh: : 是的，Ayane。作为不死之身的这段时间，让我获得了随心所欲让人头疼的能力。怕我吧。

lines.en: : Again, it...feels like I’m forgetting something!
lines.zh: : 又是……感觉我在忘记什么！

lines.en: : Ngh!
scene ineedyouback49
: I think I have some Eve in one of my pockets if you want any. No pun intended.
lines.zh: : 我口袋里好像有 Eve，你要吗？不是双关。

lines.en: : We can stop at a konbini and get you some water too. Maybe it’s dehydration?
lines.zh: : 我们可以在便利店停一下给你买点水。也许是脱水？

lines.en: scene black
: Th...Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢！

lines.en: : Mhm! That’s what friends are for.
lines.zh: : 嗯！朋友就是干这个的。

lines.en: : And once you’re feeling better, we’ll make this the greatest “Christmalloween” ever.
lines.zh: : 等你感觉好点了，我们要把这个「Christmalloween」过成有史以来最棒的一个。

lines.en: : I promise.
lines.zh: : 我保证。
